# Badge

A count on a control, where the digits are not the thing being announced.

In `library/components/badge/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-badge`

## ARIA

- **the digits** — `aria-hidden=true`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — native: reaches the control the badge is nested in, never the badge itself

**States:** tone, solid, dot, zero — the badge is removed, never drawn with a 0 in it

## Goes wrong when

- the digits are the whole badge, so its name is a bare number
- aria-hidden on the badge, which deletes the count instead of naming it
- the clipped subject added and the digits left unhidden, so the count is read twice
- the badge positioned over the control rather than nested inside it, so its words join nothing
- role=status on the badge: it interrupts, and it drops the count from the control's own name

## API

- `AC.createBadge(root) -> { set, refresh, destroy }`
- `AC.setBadge(el, count, options)`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.1 1.4.11 4.1.2 4.1.3 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/names-and-descriptions/) · see also `status-text`, `notice`, `icon-button`
